title: Execution of Che Guevara
summary: Wounded and captured by the Bolivian army on 8 October 1967 in the Quebrada del Yuro near La Higuera, Ernesto "Che" Guevara was shot the next day in the village schoolhouse on the orders of Bolivia's high command. A Cuban-American CIA operative was present.

uncertainty.note: Capture on 8 October and execution on 9 October are stated by both opened pages; the time of shooting is given as 1:10 p.m. (Rodriguez, per National Security Archive) and 1:15 p.m. (CIA memo, FRUS).

as_recorded.value: captured on 8 October 1967; executed at 1:15 p.m. on the following day (memo dated October 13, 1967)

where.historical_name: La Higuera (called Higueras in the CIA memo), Bolivia

importance.justification: The death of one of the Cuban Revolution's best-known figures ended his Bolivian campaign and made him a lasting symbol.

audience_note: Describes the summary execution of a prisoner.
